review_text: The building guard was alert when I backed up to park. Lone staff at the counter was helpful and enthusiastic. Place was clean, calm, and inviting that specific morning. Many food choices. Rates are on the pricier side. I had a delightful short visit. I'm absolutely planning to come back!

The Yolk Society is one of the newer brunch spots in Davao, and the concept is really cute. It's very egg-themed, bright, and clean. Parking, though, can be quite limited. Service was generally pleasant and professional, especially at the front of the house. However, serving time could be improved. It took over 20 minutes for just two dishes and we were the only customers at that time, yet the lasagna was served cold. To their credit, the staff apologized promptly. Food-wise, the tapa was good, and the bibingka pancake was an interesting, unique option, though a bit on the dry side. Coffee was also good. At the time of our visit, they didn't have a service invoice available. Overall, the concept is promising, but a few areas still need refinement.

Came here for the first time and loved it. The staff are so welcoming and know their menu well. Food was great and the coffee did not disappoint. That latte is creamy, a little sinful, but so worth it.

Finally another breakfast joint for Davao! I give everything a 10/10! The place is not hard to find and with plenty of parking space. We ordered TYS pancakes (classic pancakes), chicken & waffles, chicken tocino, bangus, Hojicha and TYS latte. Pancakes - soft, fluffy and tastes like bananas. Buttercream on the side is a good addition if you don't like syrup. Chicken & Waffles - chicken so crispy yet moist, seasoned nicely. Mochi waffles soft and not dry. They have a black sesame butter which is very good and have to try. Chicken tocino - made like a rice bowl is also good try because the chicken pieces used were tender with less fat making it a healthy meal. On the side they have 2 eggs of your choice of sunny side up or scrambled. Bangus - includes 2 pieces of baby Bangus with were crispy and good to pair with eggs. Hojicha - served hot or iced, we got hot. Served a little sweet but still good! TYS Latte - very creamy but not sweet, served iced which is a good drink for a hot day

I love their CS, it's our first time here and we are amazed how they cater their customers. They will ask you if you are okay, if there's something you need. Berry Matcha - 9/10 tastyy! the sweet taste of matcha blends perfectly with berry's sourness. not too sour , just enough and complimentary. Still creamy! Sulit for the price! Matcha BS - 8/10 keri lang but black sesame's taste really stand out Aglio ol yolk - 9/10 my gf enjoyed it Free Taste Bfast crunch - 9/10 i love the crisp and sweetness
Really nice food and good for cafe vibes with healthy options, for those who want dubai chewy cookie they have here for ₱110
Such a quiet and aesthetically clean place—super calming vibes. The drinks are yummy and refreshing. Definitely a nice spot to relax or catch up with friends.

A great place for people with the sweet tooth. Would definitely recommend the Bibingka Pancake and the TYS latte. Staff are friendly, and they have wifi and sockets for those who want to work. Will definitely come back!

Extremely friendly staff, I work overnight and went with my wife in morning right when they opened and staff was very accommodating and polite. We got the tocilog and French toast which was a nice take with the creams instead of syrup. The eggs for the tocino were well cooked and come with plenty of rice. Unfortunately couldn't try the coffee but looks like they had some interesting flavors to try. Will be back to try some of the other dishes and coffee. The chorizo and macadamia latte look like good next tries.
Great options for food, yummy and big servings. Relaxing ambiance and very friendly staff.
Tried the morning twist drink- it did not disappoint. The food we ordered- scrambled egg with spinach is the bomb! Try this cafe now🧡
Their place, food, and drinks are so good! Best place to chill and unwind. 👌🏻will definitely back!!
New breakfast spot in town with good coffee to start one's day!! Staff are accommodating as well!
Generous servings. Coffee is good. Taste is on point.

The Yolk Society is such a gem. Great coffee, great food, and a really cozy atmosphere. Everything we ordered was delicious and thoughtfully made. Definitely one of those places you'll want to keep coming back to.
Not only an aesthetic cafe but well curated selection of coffee and food🫶

Really nice place and really nice people. I had the espresso with pistachio and the chicken and waffles. Really delicious with no complaints there. It's maybe the best chicken I've had since Ive been traveling to Asia. It came with this black sesame oil butter that was wonderful id never had anything like it. The presentation of the food was great and the atmosphere is comfy. My wife and I brought our 4 month old son in and he was being especially needy, the cashier came over and held him for us while we ate our breakfast staying in clear view so we could wave and smile at him :)

Had a really satisfying brunch today, and it was definitely worth every peso. I ordered the chicken rice bowl and it did not disappoint. The chicken was tender, juicy, and seasoned really well, making every bite flavorful. The portion was generous and the bowl itself was very fulfilling—perfect for brunch when you want something comforting but not too heavy.

Cozy & Aesthetic Loved the cozy minimalist vibe at The Yolk Society. 🫶🏻 The pancakes bibingka were fluffy and generous with toppings, and the specialty sip golden white was smooth and perfectly brewed. Great spot for a slow brunch and some me-time with a good book. Will definitely be back! 👌🏻
Generous serving! Best place for brunch ✨✨

To be honest, the food feels average for the price. There's nothing particularly special about it—the place itself looks great, but that's about it. I'd probably visit once for the ambiance, but I don't see myself coming back knowing I'm paying premium prices for average food. If they adjusted the pricing to around the ₱100 range, it would feel more reasonable. If they want to maintain their current pricing, they should offer something more unique or memorable. They could also focus more on egg-based dishes so the store name feels more aligned with what they're offering.

We have great experience during our time there. Super love the food specially the chori and the alio olio pasta. I personally love the matcha latte oat milk with vanilla syrup. :) fast service and great ambiance.
Amazing food and a cozy ambiance! 10/10 would come back! 🤍✨
I love how they allowed us to hang inside the shop while we were waiting for it to open at 7:30am. Staff was very friendly and accommodating. Food was also good. Will definitely come back!
I dined here kanina. I have ordered their TYS latte and the umami sourdough egg. Grabe. It was very filling and the taste has depth. Not your usual cafe. Will def go back

I'm going to tell you now to order the Bibingka Pancake when you visit. Absolutely divine! I also normally don't like acidic coffee so their iced coffee with orange juice was a wonderful and delicious surprise! Bonus: they have a super cute cafe helper who sells her artworks for a bargain, make sure to get one!

I first tried their chicken and waffles, which are generously portioned and perfect for sharing—though my son could easily finish a plate himself! I appreciate that the chicken is boneless, making it easier for kids to eat. I paired it with their signature TYS latte, which is creamy and complements the espresso without overpowering it. On my second visit, I enjoyed the maple French toast with extra bacon. Once again, they impressed me with their generous servings, allowing me to skip lunch. You can really taste the care they put into their menu. I paired the French toast with another smooth latte; the espresso was just right—not too strong, making it a perfect match for my taste. Kudos to the sisters behind TYS! 🫶🏼

Great meal overall! The chicken & waffles with black sesame butter was the standout. Definitely worth trying. We also had the Good Catch rice bowl, which was fresh. The TYS latte was smooth, milky, and nicely balanced. Would happily come back again.
Good atmosphere. Aesthetic place and very chill. Big serving. Nice place to eat and visit. Recommended.
Food is pretty and delish! So satisfied!😋
Love the ambience. Food is such a comfort for anyone who wants to have meal, coffee is cracking good too. 😊
spanish latte is good!
food is fantastic, service is splendid, atmosphere is amazing, and the people are phenomenal 😳😳🥰🥰😍😍🤤🤤 …
Amazing food and their matcha tastes good! Plus free stickers!
E yol! This place is so high ate! Best breaky grub down south! 🥚 🐣 🍳
Great service, all of their foods are worth it! ✨
Good eggs and breakfast food nearby and hojicha
New cozy breakfast place
Good ambiance
Staff is realy approachable, the enviroment is nice
Service is great, atmosphere is friendly, food is amazing. Will come back
The atmosphere is great
trendy + chic ! very for the beige & soft look. food & drinks were good though they were pricey but still delicious!
i love the hojicha

It is THE SOCIETY! The Yolk Society is, I wouldn't say just another silogan, but I bet this is the silogan you'd love to have on a high street! They gave silog the twist you didn't ask for, but your palate would definitely appreciate and love. We ordered the hearty Cho-Rice-Zo, with a generous serving of Pinoy garlic chorizo, and their Society Omelette that Dexter from Dexter's Laboratory would looove. The twists in their dishes are mostly inspired by familiar Pinoy flavors, which makes them even more enjoyable. The Bibingka Pancake is surprisingly gooood. It is what bibingka should be, matambok, except without the cracks. HAHAHAHA. It is also what pancakes should be, fluffy! The toppings are bursting with flavor and texture. This is definitely a must-try. Pair it with their signature coffee, the TYS Latte, and your snack will be a bomb. If you're looking to carbo-load, come here!

We came all the way from General Santos because this restaurant was highly recommended, and we were really looking forward to trying it. The food definitely lived up to the hype—it was delicious, well-prepared, and worth the wait in terms of quality. Unfortunately, the service was disappointing. We waited about one hour for our food, even though we ordered before other tables. It was frustrating to see guests who arrived and ordered after us receive their meals first while we were still waiting. We understand that restaurants can get busy, but we hope the staff can improve their order management and communication with customers. The food is excellent, but the long wait and the way orders were handled took away from what could have been a great dining experience.

Ordered TYS latte and cheese roll. Latte is V V V V CREAMY the best iced latte i had (yet). Over all vibe is 10/10, good AC, music, lighting, js loved the furnitures and decor :) pleasing to eyes. + there is parking space so its a plus

The place was nice and comfortable, with a cute, bright, and sunny aesthetic. The staff who served us was proactive and very accommodating. I highly recommend the classic pasta and the mochi waffle. We were also given a complimentary mango matcha, which turned out to be such a delicious and refreshing combination of flavors. A thoughtful touch and definitely a must-try.

Love the place and food/menu selection! The food and drinks are delicious and big servings. It's worth the money. You can read a book here because it's not too noisy. Chairs are comfy. The ambiance is nice. It's more for catching up with a friend and not for studying because there are not many outlets. Also loved the free sticker, as someone who keeps a journal, can be used for ephemera :D

Their food is super delicious, especially the Bibingka pancake. Not too sweet, very Filipino in taste with the coconut chips and muscovado toppings, and the butter tastes like egg yolk from the boiled egg. Really a must visit cafe in Davao.
